topic_evidence_limits.When Might Lip Filler Fit Your Goal?: Added fullness/shape and formulation-specific uses; goals/photo prompts are counseling guidance, not outcome promises or inventory.

topic_evidence_limits.What Risks Should You Understand Before: FDA risks/patient advice and toxin warnings/precautions support serious symptoms and immediate help. Product-wide warnings are not lip-specific event rates. Pregnancy/breastfeeding safety unknown is not asserted as a universal formal contraindication; no instruction to stop prescribed medicines.
topic_evidence_limits.Can You Reverse Either Treatment?: HA dissolution potential, repeat-treatment/allergy limits from consensus; no universal reversal, rescue guarantee or Estar emergency capability claim. Toxin recovery differs from HA dissolution.
topic_evidence_limits.How Should You Compare the Cost?: Reader questions from D5/D8 and temporary-treatment/touch-up evidence; not empirical price, fee, savings, cost-effectiveness or maintenance-frequency claims.
topic_evidence_limits.What Should You Ask at Estar MedSpa?: Website-supported consultation approach and named roles/credentials/general injectable context only; no independent registry verification, complete roster or lip procedure assignment. Product-name discrepancy remains in C4; provider booking follow-up corroborates missing association.
topic_evidence_limits.Common Questions About Lip Flips and Lip: No naturalness/superiority promise. Gummy-smile muscle distinction uses abstract-only 10-person study, not a universal treatment recommendation. FDA combination guidance: safe combined use not evaluated in controlled clinical study; not a prohibition.
topic_evidence_limits.Talk Through Your Lip Goals in Olney: Supported Olney location/contact number and reachable pathway; no clinician, slot, fee, stock or candidacy promise. Required provider CTA marker retained.
